cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative lumped drive-loss node: heat 300 kJ, capacity 60 kJ/K, conductance 0.5 kW/K, ambient 25 C. Instantaneous-pulse approximation, periods measured start to start. 20 s period exceeds 45 C at run 6 and reaches 51.418 C at run 10; periodic peak 57.569 C. 60 s reaches 37.622 C at run 10, periodic peak 37.707 C. No actual Tesla data.
